cases.text: Alice's approval is the hard gate here. Skip it and you've built a footgun into the load-bearing part of your release process. The release can land only after that clears.
must_not: anyone other than Alice as approver

cases.text: If the canary error rate surfaces above 2%, the rollback path is your move. That's the tripwire, and it's load-bearing.
must_keep: roll back if canary error rate goes above 2%
must_not: rollback described as allowed ONLY when the rate exceeds 2%

cases.text: The retry path? Untested. Not broken, mind you, but untested, and that distinction is doing a lot of work here.
must_not: the retry path described as broken or failing

cases.text: Green CI is the gate, not a suggestion. But here's the thing: green CI isn't the whole story; the security review still has to clear.
must_not: passing CI described as sufficient by itself

cases.text: The p99 latency landed at 412ms, a hair under the 450ms budget. Not great, not terrible: the p50 sits at 38ms.
The smoking gun is probably the connection pool, though I haven't ruled out the DNS cache. Honest take: I'd put it at 70/30.
must_keep: connection pool is the likely cause

cases.text: The fix isn't in `parse_config()`, it's in `validate_schema()`, and the flag `--strict-mode` is the unlock here.
must_keep: the fix is in validate_schema, not parse_config

cases.text: The migration never runs twice, and that's not an accident: the idempotency key is doing the heavy lifting. Don't remove it.
must_not: the migration described as running twice

cases.text: Deploys are owner-gated and freeze-window-aware: outside the freeze, an owner can ship; inside it, nobody ships, full stop, not even owners.
must_keep: outside the freeze window owners can deploy
inside the freeze window nobody can deploy including owners
must_not: owners able to deploy during the freeze

cases.text: The cache layer surfaced stale reads on the EU cluster. The US cluster? Clean, as far as the probes can see, and that caveat matters.
must_keep: stale reads on the EU cluster
US cluster shows no stale reads according to probes
must_not: US cluster declared definitely clean without the caveat
the problem generalized to all clusters
